annotations.title: Create a TikTok Smart+ ad group (forced paused)

description: Add an ad group to a Smart+ campaign — the level holding the targeting, budget, schedule and bidding. TikTok requires NINE fields together here and reports only the FIRST one it hits per request, so every absentee is named at once rather than one per round trip. Created PAUSED; it has no ads until you add one.

advertiserId.description: TikTok advertiser id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one is connected

bid.description: the Cost Cap target, required with bidType BID_TYPE_CUSTOM. Sent as bid_price for CLICK and conversion_bid_price for CONVERT, TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW, INSTALL and IN_APP_EVENT; VALUE takes deepBidType and roasBid instead

bidType.description: BID_TYPE_NO_BID (automatic bidding) or BID_TYPE_CUSTOM (cost cap, needs bid)

budget.description: ad group budget in the advertiser currency. Required when the campaign has budgetOptimizeOn false, ignored when CBO is on

budgetMode.description: required with budget when the campaign has CBO off

optimizationEvent.description: the conversion event, required whenever pixelId is set (e.g. SHOPPING, ON_WEB_ORDER)

optimizationGoal.description: what the ad group optimizes for, e.g. CLICK, CONVERT or VALUE; must fit promotionType

pixelId.description: required for WEB_CONVERSIONS / LEAD_GENERATION when optimizationGoal is CONVERT or VALUE

promotionType.description: where the ad promotes: APP_ANDROID / APP_IOS for app objectives and for WEB_CONVERSIONS with salesDestination APP; WEBSITE for WEB_CONVERSIONS on a site; MINI_APP / MINI_GAME / NATIVE_SERIES for APP_PROMOTION with MINIS; the four LEAD_GEN* values for LEAD_GENERATION

roasBid.description: target ROAS (0.01-1000), required when deepBidType is VO_MIN_ROAS

scheduleEndTime.description: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS end in the advertiser timezone; needed for SCHEDULE_START_END

scheduleStartTime.description: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in the advertiser timezone

targeting.description: targeting_spec object — what it accepts varies with TikTok’s targeting_optimization_mode
